snippet.title: Cordel Lands - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Cordel Lands is a top-down roguelite action-adventure game with hack-n-slash combat, set in a mystical Brazilian northeastern hinterland.

Game Demo on July 21, 2025!
